cost.a: FitMyCV Premium is ${lifetime} for lifetime access (pay once, keep it forever) or ${month} per month with no contracts.

includes.q: What do I get with Premium?
includes.a: Premium includes unlimited tailored CVs and cover letters from any job link, a match score and ATS score on every CV, interview prep with company research and outreach, daily job matches by email, and PDF export on everything.

cancel.a: Monthly subscriptions can be canceled anytime. You keep access until the end of your billing period. Lifetime purchases are one-time and non-refundable.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Payments are processed securely through Polar, which accepts all major credit and debit cards.

regional.a: Yes. Lower pricing may apply in select countries based on your location at checkout.

meta.title: AI Resume Tailor: Tailor Your CV to a Job Description | FitMyCV
meta.description: An AI resume tailor that matches your CV to the job description. Paste a link from LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor or a careers page and get a CV and cover letter.

tailorCvFromJobLink.titleStart: Tailor your CV to a job description,
tailorCvFromJobLink.intro: Tailor your resume to a job description with AI: paste a job link from LinkedIn, Indeed, or any board, or paste the posting text, and FitMyCV rewrites your CV and cover letter to match the role, keyword for keyword.
tailorCvFromJobLink.benefitsTitle: One job link. A CV built for that role.
tailorCvFromJobLink.benefitsIntro: Stop sending the same generic resume to every posting. FitMyCV tailors a fresh CV from each job link you paste.

link.title: Paste a link, not a wall of text
link.body: Drop in a job URL from LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, or any board. FitMyCV reads the role and pulls out the requirements, skills, and keywords, including the sections hidden behind a 'see more' toggle.

ats.title: Built to pass ATS filters
ats.body: Your CV is rewritten to mirror the exact language in the listing, then exported as a single-column, text-based PDF that applicant tracking systems parse the way you wrote it.

speed.title: CV + cover letter in seconds
speed.body: Both documents come from the same parse of the same posting, so they reinforce each other. Edit either inline, then export to recruiter-ready PDFs with one click.
